_comment: Screen mode's cross-process contract. The desktop shell (desktop/screen-mode.js) names sessions and screenshots and writes events.json; the backend (backend/screen_sessions.py) adopts, serves, keeps and deletes them; the renderer (frontend/src/screen-annotations.ts) reads the manifest. Each side's suite checks its constants against this file, so a rename on one side fails the build instead of silently orphaning screenshots.

archivedManifest._comment: What the backend adds when it adopts a session beside its recording: the epoch ms of the recording's first audio sample. Marks are placed from this, on every transcript of the recording.
